args.message: Here is each store's best 2025 month by pre-tax sales (net_sales, in dollars). Each store's average uses only the months it was open. That's 12 months for most stores, 8 for New Orleans (May–Dec) and 2 for Los Angeles (Nov–Dec). Both of those stores opened mid-month, so their first month is a partial one but still counts in the average. Los Angeles has only two months of data, so its figures rest on a very small sample. The last column is the best month divided by the average, minus 1.
